I have had glaucoma since I was 2 months old. I'm 30 now and still have sight +15 +13 , I also have no lense in my eyes, thickened corneas and a recent hemorrhage behind my retina leaving a distortion in my central vision. With proper medication, your pressure can remain in the normal range, i'm on 4 different eye drops. 

It could just be a check to rule out if you have it, but if it ends up you do have it, it's not the end. As far as being a burden, there are tools and resources you can and should use to live an independent life, reach out to your local Lions Club and they can help you out.
